text:
mike: Heads up, docs-only PR landed. Change window tonight; can we avoid bumping patch?
releasebot: Current rule: every merge -> patch bump. No docs-only exception.
anya: I'm in favor of skipping for docs, but we need an audit tag for ops.
sofia: What about downstream pins? Some partners pin exact tags and watch changelogs.
anya: Minimal compromise: add label 'no-patch' that triggers a meta-tag `meta/<short>` and a changelog line 'docs-only: no semver bump'.
mike: That preserves rollback references and keeps public semver stable.
sofia: Also require docs reviewer and block if any build artifacts changed.
releasebot: I can implement: label check -> diff whitelist -> create meta tag -> post release note. Will default to bump on ambiguity.
mike: Sweet. Action: anya -> PR to releasebot; sofia -> confirm pins from partners; i'll update changelog template.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled 21:30 UTC.
anya: Opening PR now :shipit:
sofia: I'll run pin-check and post results in #support before EOD.
mike: Thanks everyone, will monitor the deploy.
